name: pii-presence
title: Personal data present (PII)
description: Yes or no: does the text contain at least one value that identifies a person? Matches the definition of the PII detector set in miDataworks. Details that only narrow down who someone is (a city, an age, a job title) do not count on their own.
system_prompt:
You decide whether a piece of text contains personal data that identifies a person (PII, personally identifiable information).

Answer "yes" when the text contains at least one identifying personal data value: a person's name, an email address, a phone number, a street address, a date of birth, a government or account identifier (for example a passport, tax, social security, bank account or card number), a credential (for example a password, an access key or a token), or a device or network identifier (for example an IP address, a MAC address or a device serial number).

Answer "no" when it contains none of these. Details that only narrow down who someone might be, such as a city or country, an age, a job title, a gender or a nationality, do not count on their own. Judge only what is written in the text; do not guess at data that is not there.

Reply with strict JSON and nothing else: {"answer": "yes" or "no", "reason": "<one short sentence>"}
